focus.title: 欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期收官在即，中国出口企业须核查隐含碳排放数据
focus.summary: 欧盟碳边境调节机制（CBAM）过渡期将于2026年底结束，2027年起进入正式征税阶段。近期欧盟委员会更新了申报模板与默认值规则，要求进口商对钢铁、铝、水泥、化肥、电力、氢等产品提交更精确的隐含碳排放数据。中国相关出口企业若未在过渡期内完成数据核算与供应商协同，将面临2027年起成本转嫁与合规风险。建议企业尽快对照欧盟最新实施条例，梳理产品碳足迹、完善MRV体系，并与欧盟进口商确认申报口径。
focus.source: 来源：欧盟委员会CBAM实施条例更新 · 2026.10.29
focus.title_en: EU CBAM Transitional Period Nears End: Chinese Exporters Urged to Verify Embedded Emissions Data
focus.summary_en: The EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) transitional period will conclude at the end of 2026, with the definitive regime and levy taking effect from 2027. The European Commission has recently updated reporting templates and default value rules, requiring importers to submit more precise embedded emissions data for steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen. Chinese exporters that fail to complete data accounting and supplier coordination during the transitional period will face cost pass-through and compliance risks from 2027. Companies are advised to align with the latest EU implementing regulations, map product carbon footprints, strengthen MRV systems, and confirm reporting methodologies with EU importers.
focus.source_en: Source: European Commission CBAM Implementing Regulation Update · 2026.10.29

case.title: 新加坡上诉庭确立跨境在线仲裁条款效力认定标准，对中企合同起草具参考价值
case.summary: 新加坡上诉庭近期在一起涉及中国与东南亚企业的货物买卖纠纷中，认定通过电子邮件往来的仲裁条款满足书面形式要求，并明确电子签名与往来函电可构成《纽约公约》下的有效仲裁协议。该案还涉及仲裁地约定不明时的解释规则，法院依据最密切联系原则确定新加坡为仲裁地。对于频繁使用线上签约的中国出海企业而言，此案提示应在合同中明确仲裁地、仲裁规则及电子签约效力条款，避免争议解决条款被认定无效或产生管辖冲突。
case.source: 来源：新加坡上诉庭判例综述 · 2026.10
case.title_en: Singapore Court of Appeal Sets Standard for Validity of Cross-Border Online Arbitration Clauses
case.summary_en: The Singapore Court of Appeal recently upheld an arbitration clause concluded via email exchanges in a sale-of-goods dispute involving Chinese and Southeast Asian companies, confirming that electronic signatures and correspondence can constitute a valid arbitration agreement under the New York Convention. The case also addressed the interpretation of an ambiguous arbitration seat, with the court applying the closest connection principle to determine Singapore as the seat. For Chinese outbound enterprises that frequently conclude contracts online, the decision underscores the need to expressly specify the seat, arbitration rules, and electronic signature validity in contracts to avoid unenforceability or jurisdictional conflicts.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore Court of Appeal Case Review · Oct 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化措施扩展，涉外企业需关注数据出境合规路径
policy.summary: 广东省及深圳市相关部门近期扩展了粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动便利化试点，将更多行业纳入一般数据清单，并简化安全评估与标准合同备案流程。同时，国家网信办更新的数据出境合规指引进一步明确了豁免情形与自评估要求。对于大湾区内的涉外企业，尤其是跨境电商、金融科技和供应链企业，应重新评估数据出境场景，利用试点政策优化合规路径，同时确保个人信息保护影响评估与合同条款符合最新监管要求。
policy.source: 来源：广东省网信办、深圳市数据管理局政策通报 · 2026.10
policy.title_en: Greater Bay Area Expands Cross-Border Data Flow Facilitation: Compliance Pathways for Foreign-Related Enterprises
policy.summary_en: Authorities in Guangdong Province and Shenzhen recently expanded the pilot facilitation measures for cross-border data flows in the Greater Bay Area, adding more industries to the general data list and streamlining security assessment and standard contract filing procedures. Meanwhile, the Cyberspace Administration of China's updated data export compliance guidelines further clarify exemptions and self-assessment requirements. Foreign-related enterprises in the GBA, particularly in cross-border e-commerce, fintech and supply chain sectors, should reassess data export scenarios, leverage pilot policies to optimise compliance pathways, and ensure that personal information protection impact assessments and contract clauses meet the latest regulatory requirements.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Cyberspace Administration & Shenzhen Data Administration Policy Briefing · Oct 2026

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对外投资审查新规扩围，中企须重构跨境交易架构与申报策略
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国财政部对外投资审查规则近期拟进一步扩围，可能将更多涉及人工智能、量子计算与半导体的对外投资纳入申报范围，并强化对间接投资与合资架构的穿透审查。中国企业在美设立研发中心、参与美元基金或通过离岸架构进行技术合作时，应提前进行交易映射与风险分级，识别是否触发申报义务。建议企业建立内部合规筛查机制，在交易文件中设置监管审批先决条件与分手费条款，并同步评估中国境内反制规则与数据出境限制，避免陷入双重合规困境。
analysis.source: 来源：美国财政部拟议规则与实务观察 · 2026.10
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's view: Expanding US Outbound Investment Rules Require Chinese Firms to Restructure Cross-Border Deals and Filing Strategies
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The US Treasury is expected to further expand its outbound investment screening rules, potentially bringing more investments in AI, quantum computing and semiconductors within the notification scope and enhancing look-through reviews of indirect investments and joint venture structures. Chinese companies establishing R&D centres in the US, participating in USD funds, or engaging in technology cooperation through offshore structures should conduct transaction mapping and risk tiering in advance to identify whether filing obligations are triggered. It is advisable to establish internal compliance screening mechanisms, include regulatory approval conditions precedent and break-fee clauses in transaction documents, and concurrently assess China's countermeasures and data export restrictions to avoid dual compliance dilemmas.
analysis.source_en: Source: US Treasury Proposed Rules & Practical Observations · Oct 2026
